verdict.rationale: Check documents a first-party MCP Server that lets users "use natural language to generate reports, manage employees, run payroll, and more" from AI clients such as Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. It ships as a hosted URL with OAuth or API-key auth, or as a self-hosted server, and the docs include an example natural-language prompt for generating an employee CSV. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: use natural language to generate reports, manage employees, run payroll, and more — directly from the AI tools you already use.
The Check MCP Server works with any MCP-compatible client, including: Claude Desktop, Claude Code (CLI), Cursor, GitHub Copilot (VS Code), ChatGPT
Connect directly from your AI client with just a URL — no repo to clone, no Python to install.
Generate a CSV of all employees at company X with their federal W-4 filing status, dependents amount, and additional withholding
